why: Tier-1 developer tooling: scripts/ops/check_backlog_refs.py and tests/test_check_backlog_refs.py. No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no order path, no strategy config, no risk caps, and NO register change -- this is an improvement, not a defect being left, so no backlog row is filed for appearance. R12 does not apply -- checked against LANDING_MACHINERY rather than assumed: check_backlog_refs.py is not in that list, which names the automerge/pr-opener/board-post workflows, check_pr_landing.py, check_automerge_trigger.py, session_registry.py, claim_merge_slot.py and commit-to-main/action.yml. WHAT IT DOES: on a dangling tracking reference the guard now names the filed row the reference is TRUNCATING, instead of stopping at 'correct the id if it is a typo/rename' against a 1876-id register. BASIS: MEASURED over every dangling reference this guard raised against one session's branches on 2026-09-13 -- n=3, one session, one author, population stated because it is small and establishes no rate. ALL THREE were exact PREFIXES of a real filed row and none was a typo: two elided in prose, one LINE-WRAPPED across a docstring. The failure mode is REFORMATTING, which truncates rather than garbles, so prefix leads and difflib is the fallback -- ordering that is load-bearing, since a fuzzy match on a truncated id can score a DIFFERENT row well. FOUR STATES, NEVER COLLAPSED: prefix (1-3 named) / ambiguous (too many start with it, so the COUNT is the answer and no arbitrary alphabetical pick is offered) / fuzzy / none. Measured on the live register, a bare date prefix matches 9 rows and a date-plus-common-word prefix matches 29, which is why 'show the first three' was rejected. RESTRAINT: diff-scoped mode ONLY (--all is report-only by design for the alarm-fatigue reason the module's own docstring gives, and dozens of findings times four lines is an unreadable report); it SUGGESTS and never rewrites; and a minimum prefix length stops a short prefix matching hundreds of rows and calling it help. CONTROLS: 41 tests, and five planted defects each observed reddening its own -- prefix branch removed; ambiguity collapsed into prefix; hint rendered when empty (the decoration direction); fuzzy cutoff loosened so it invents help; min-prefix floor removed. Verified END-TO-END against the real guard output, not only the pure function. NOTED: the first draft QUOTED two truncated ids in a comment, so this file carried a dangling reference and the guard refused its own source; they are described rather than quoted now.
